subject: Mutual action plan and private offer path — Redwood / Novawave
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@novawave.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan and private offer path — Redwood / Novawave

Hi Linda and Novawave procurement team,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our call I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) to get Novawave from evaluation -> acceptance -> private offer on marketplace. High level:

- 3 week evaluation (week 0: technical kickoff + data access; week 1: performance & acceptance tests; week 2: pilot wrap and signoff)
- Acceptance criteria: latency and cost envelope (SLA targets attached), integration smoke tests, and business-case validation with one production flow
- Procurement path: we recommend the AWS Marketplace private offer (customer-side PO + marketplace invoice) so billing flows through AWS while preserving escrow and committed capacity options. If you require direct Redwood invoicing we can route via a short SOW + invoice, but that adds ~5 business days.
- Owners: Redwood will own model provisioning and onboarding (Jordan), procurement cadence and marketplace activation (Karthik), legal/finance touchpoints (Marissa).

I've attached a one-page MAP (Redwood_MAP_Novawave_v1.pdf) that shows week-by-week checkpoints and the minimal legal/billing artifacts we need from your side. Can you confirm which billing path you prefer (Marketplace private offer with PO vs. Redwood invoice)? Also please share the procurement contact and any internal PO timelines.

Next steps: if Marketplace private offer is OK we will: 1) prepare the private offer and send a DocuSign SOW for signature, 2) schedule the technical acceptance runbook with your infra team, 3) enable marketplace billing once the PO is uploaded.

Thanks — I can meet next Tue/Wed for a 30m follow-up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0143

Marissa,

Appreciate the summary and the MAP. A few quick questions from procurement/legal:

1) We need a short SOC 2 summary and data retention guarantees to attach to the PO — can you send that?
2) For the Marketplace private offer — will Novawave be invoiced by AWS and pay via our normal PO process, or do we need to route a PO to Redwood directly? Which is quicker?
3) Pricing: can you provide an estimated monthly burn for the pilot (approximately 100k tokens / day baseline) and an expected committed discount threshold? We need numbers to justify the PO.
4) Who will be the acceptance gate on Redwood's side (name + email) so we can add them to the mutual action plan?

If we can get SOC 2 and the cost estimate today, procurement will triage and get a PO number issued by next Friday. We prefer Marketplace invoicing if there are no gaps on SOC 2 / billing terms.

Thanks,
Linda Park
VP, Procurement
Novawave Systems
Linda.Park@novawave.com

Hi Linda — thanks, and great questions. Answers below and attached artifacts.

1) SOC2: attached is a short SOC2 summary (Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf) highlighting scope and controls relevant to inference and data handling. We can provide the full attestation under NDA if your legal needs it.

2) Billing path: Marketplace private offer is the recommended path and the quicker route for most customers. Flow we typically use: Novawave issues PO to AWS (or attaches PO to the private offer), AWS invoices Novawave, Redwood receives payment settlement via AWS. If you need Redwood invoicing instead we will accept PO to Redwood but that route requires an SOW and adds ~3–7 business days. For the pilot we can proceed with Marketplace unless legal raises a blocker.

3) Cost estimate for pilot (approx figures): baseline pilot (3 weeks) ~ $8,500–$12,000 total depending on sequence length and concurrency. Committed discount tiers start at 15% for a 6 month reserved capacity commit. I included a short price sheet in the attached MAP doc (Redwood_MAP_Novawave_v2.docx). We'll finalize numbers once we have telemetry from your acceptance run.

4) Acceptance gate: Jordan Blake (jordan.blake@redwood.ai) will be the primary technical acceptance owner; Karthik will run the marketplace activation and procurement checkpoint. I'll be the commercial/legal lead for signoff.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Novawave_v2.docx (MAP with pricing and acceptance checklist), Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf

DocuSign: I shared a pre-populated SOW (link below) that you can sign once procurement confirms the PO number.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/sign/abc123

Best,
